g.text: Scan conversation sessions exceeding 20 uncompressed turns
Prompt LLM to extract key user facts, preferences and discussion summary
Update conversation session with new condensed summary block
Archive older raw message turns to cold storage
Compaction reduces LLM token costs by over 70% on long-running multi-day conversations
